rongmei.title: Ramguay ta khang suang kung liang e

lines: 1. Ramh guay ta khang suang kung liang e,
Suina kaap kaganv thui ;
Guangh zau suna kandi ram khou hei,
Guangh dailiangmei zanta thuan ku khang .
Ha-leluija kao liang meipu,
Kandi namru zingpui ram tazik ramc khou hei,
Nangta lum ma ai ning na bam e,
Guang o kalloumei pu guang jisu.
2. Ring pui panty zingc pui dih khou hei,
Kanloumei pata huai;
Tuai makpui ram guang khang khuanc ngam mak
Sam guang o tuai dat mak pui ramc tei,
3. Ringpui ganv tingsaeng bam sini
Khuanc bam e kanan ramc ;
Neimik rui kei dat makpui ramc tei,
Neihlamei guang pirunc tei la khang .
4. Guang rui lungpui ram zion nam daih,
Tingkao kandih guang dai;
He halleluijah tuna thuan e
Nthan mei guang ta ding huam lana.
